I have completed a comprehensive cleanup of the entire codebase across JavaScript, CSS, and HTML files.

### 1. JavaScript Bug Fixes & Refactoring
- **Fixed Layout Injector Runtime Exception**: Resolved `Uncaught ReferenceError: footerHTML is not defined` in [html-injector.js](https://github.com/KyleBemmann/kylebemmann.github.io/blob/main/scripts/html-injector.js), which previously crashed script execution and blocked page navigation initialization.
- **Fixed Global Identifier Collision**: Removed duplicate top-level declarations of `const nesting` that caused `Uncaught SyntaxError: Identifier 'nesting' has already been declared` when loading [script.js](https://github.com/KyleBemmann/kylebemmann.github.io/blob/main/scripts/script.js).
- **Consolidated Navigation & Theme Controls**: Replaced redundant jQuery and Bootstrap JS dependencies with lightweight, native Vanilla JS in [theme.js](https://github.com/KyleBemmann/kylebemmann.github.io/blob/main/scripts/theme.js):
  - Immediate pre-render theme & dark mode restoration (prevents color flickering on page load).
  - Robust theme switcher toggle with active theme indicator and `localStorage` persistence.
  - Desktop & mobile dropdowns and hamburger drawer toggling with outside-click dismissal.
  - Active page link and parent section highlighting based on current URL path.
  - Smooth scroll-to-top button controls.
- **Direct Layout Injection**: Updated [html-injector.js](https://github.com/KyleBemmann/kylebemmann.github.io/blob/main/scripts/html-injector.js) to inject markup directly into the `<inject-html>` tag rather than inside the `.layout` CSS Grid.
- **Timer Refactoring**: Updated the countdown script in [eventually.html](https://github.com/KyleBemmann/kylebemmann.github.io/blob/main/pages/eventually.html) from string `eval` (`setInterval("tick()", 1000)`) to a function reference (`setInterval(tick, 1000)`) with safe DOM element handling.

### 2. CSS Corrections & Optimizations
- **Fixed Dark Mode Text Contrast**: Corrected `--text-1` from `#111111` to `#F5F5F5` and added `:root.darkmode` in [theme.css](https://github.com/KyleBemmann/kylebemmann.github.io/blob/main/css/theme.css) so body text and links are readable in dark mode.
- **Fixed Comment Syntax Typo**: Corrected comment delimiter in [navigation.css](https://github.com/KyleBemmann/kylebemmann.github.io/blob/main/css/navigation.css#L285).
- **Active Navigation Styling**: Added visual highlight styles for current navigation links (`.active`) and open category parents (`.active-parent`).
- **Removed Dead Code**: Cleared over 90 lines of commented-out, unclosed keyframe animations in [animation.css](https://github.com/KyleBemmann/kylebemmann.github.io/blob/main/css/animation.css).
- **Layout CSS Normalization**: Formatted and trimmed excess whitespace in [0.css](https://github.com/KyleBemmann/kylebemmann.github.io/blob/main/css/0.css), [1.css](https://github.com/KyleBemmann/kylebemmann.github.io/blob/main/css/1.css), [2.css](https://github.com/KyleBemmann/kylebemmann.github.io/blob/main/css/2.css), and [stylesheet.css](https://github.com/KyleBemmann/kylebemmann.github.io/blob/main/css/stylesheet.css).

### 3. HTML Markup Cleanup Across All 73 Pages
- **Removed 485 Empty `style=""` Attributes**: Cleaned up leftover empty style tags on images across all subpages.
- **Removed Empty `<style>` Tags**: Stripped empty `<style></style>` blocks across 72 pages (preserving the mobile sidebar media query in [christmas.html](https://github.com/KyleBemmann/kylebemmann.github.io/blob/main/pages/christmas.html)).
- **Streamlined Script Loading**: Removed unused external CDN scripts (`bootstrap.bundle.min.js`, `jquery.min.js`), reducing initial page weight by ~170 KB, and properly ordered local scripts with `defer`.
- **Trimmed Trailing Lines**: Cleaned up trailing blank lines at the end of [index.html](https://github.com/KyleBemmann/kylebemmann.github.io/blob/main/index.html) and all files in `pages/`.
